dct_alternative_sm: Tax Incremental Financing Districts Milwaukee, Wisconsin 2026
dct_creator_sm: City of Milwaukee Department of City Development
dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer represents 135 tax incremental district features in the City of Milwaukee, Wisconsin as of September 17, 2026. Tax Incremental Financing is an economic development tool used by the City to leverage private development investment. Milwaukee has created more than 121 Tax Incremental Districts to support projects ranging from major business and infrastructure investments to neighborhood-scale development. The source portal states that the dataset is refreshed nightly. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
